mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 2.0% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in non-farm payrolls indicate labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: New single-family housing starts exceeding 900,000 units signal strong consumer spending and wealth effects, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 900.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rate over the prior month indicates weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: New single-family housing starts falling below 850,000 units signals housing sector contraction, reducing consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 850.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production and quarterly GDP growth signal manufacturing sector weakness and economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO and GDPC1 both decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI index exceeding 230.0 indicates high inflation, prompting central bank tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
